title: Changed `manualColumnFreeze` so that frozen columns can be dragged and columns can be dropped in front of them, as with `fixedColumnsStart`; to keep the old lock, return `false` from `beforeColumnMove`, as shown in the migration guide. Added the `restoreColumnPosition` option of `manualColumnFreeze`, a `finalIndex` argument to the `beforeColumnUnfreeze` and `afterColumnUnfreeze` hooks, and fixed the drop guideline being hidden under frozen columns and the selection staying on the old column after a freeze or unfreeze from the menu.
